nom: Bliss Jelly Glow Peel Enzyme Cleanser and Exfoliator - 4 Oz - Vegan Formula

avis.titre: Excellent Product, coming from a former Esthetician
avis.texte: I have read the reviews on this I do not understand why no one has ever done the "test," on a product to see if it is the product that is rolling up or if your dead, flaky skin is actually coming off. Steps for the test: Get a smooth surface: bottom of a glass bowl will do. Put on gloves; keeps your skin from being exposed to product. Wet bottom of bowl; see instructions on tube. Put small amount of product on gloved fingertips. Start "applying" product to bottom of bowl in circular motion; once again see instructions on tube. Massage product in circular motion for 30 seconds or longer. Did the product bead up and become gummy? No, then the product isn't to blame for the gummy beads. Did the product just get spread in a large circular pattern? Second part of Test: Apply warm water to back of opposite hand or arm from the gloved hand. Apply small amount of product to gloved finger tips. Apply to back of hand or arm in a circular motion. Massage product for 30 seconds or longer. Did product bead up? If yes, then this is your old skin releasing and being removed. Did product evaporate and do nothing? Then this product isn't for you, you do not have dry skin issues. I spent several years looking for a product like this, I used something very similar to this for extremely dry or acned skin in facials. Only kicker it cost up to $600 retail of one ounce. I couldn't even afford it at Wholesale price. This works exactly like it is supposed to and is excellent for skin the is eczemic,

I have been repurchasing this for years now, I will never remove it from my skin care routine!! I have very dry and sensitive skin, but this is an absolute necessity for me in getting all the flaky skin off my face so that my makeup applies smoothly and my skin looks smooth and glowy overall. Some reviewers have mentioned that it can be difficult to rinse off completely, which I do agree with to some extent, but really it just takes a little longer to rinse off than a typical face wash. Additionally, I use this in the middle of my double cleanser face wash routine; after removing my makeup with micellar water, I use an oil cleanser to remove any additional dirt & makeup, then this Bliss Jelly Scrub, and follow with my second hydrating glycerin based cleanser using a soft face wash brush. I really like to use my second cleanser after the exfoliating scrub to help lift and rinse any remaining product off my face and neck as well as ensure that the new skin under all the dry skin that was removed is fresh and clean before applying my toners, face masks, serums, moisturizer, etc. My skin can be acne prone as well, but I find that this exfoliator does not irritate or break me out. In fact, I love how well it smooths out the dry skin around any healing spots without stripping my skin barrier or causing any further irritation, allowing my face to heal and renew much quicker than without it. avis.titre: Really, really works! Not a gimmick!!
avis.texte: This product is a game changer! I have extremely dry skin that flakes all winter long making it near impossible to put on makeup without it looking cakey and terrible. I bought this thinking it may well be just a gimmick. I assure you, it is not! The first time I used it it immediately balled up under my fingers (weird) and I washed it off. I did a second peel just to see, and I got a lot fewer balls and I had to scrub pretty vigorously to get any. I did a 3rd wash just to see and NO little balls at all. Crazy! Then I put on moisturizer and it was like my skin was brand new. Mind you the product is completely smooth and feels so gentle like you aren't doing anything abrasive. I have used a clairsonic, had dermaplaning facials, scrubbed with an abrasive facial sponge, NOTHING has helped my peely skin like this. Been using about 3-4 times a week. I will say the little balls of skin are kinda pesky to get rid of as some reviewers also said. They'll get stuck in your hair if you're not careful. I just do my peel before I shower so i can be sure they all get washed away. Totally, totally worth it. I'll be a customer for life.

I remember purchasing this product a long time ago from Ulta and loving it. I just repurchased this and was so excited to use it.. well while using it it formed little balls of I’m assuming dead skin and trying to get them off was difficult.. I guess it’s because I haven’t exfoliated in a very long time but once I finally got them removed (which I used my fingers/nails and a face towel) my face is sooo soft. I will use this about twice a week as it’s not good to exfoliate everyday even though it says you can.

avis.titre: So glad it’s back!!!! Best enzyme exfoliation ev-ah!
avis.texte: I’m stocking up now that it’s back because it’s the only exfoliant that I’ve found that actually works. Sloughs off old dry skin, so moisturizers can actually work, pores seem clearer, and makeup goes on smoother. I could be wrong, but it seems to work even better now that they brought it back! I’d advise dermaplaning first unless you don’t mind scrubbing off the dead skin that may stick to facial hair.
Honestly top dog in exfoliators. Devastated when it disappeared for a year or so, BUT not impressed with the price now!

I have Quite a bit of flakiness and dead skin cells on my face due to medications I'm taking and being in the hospital for quite some time. Was hoping this cleanser would help. It does work on most of my face.....sadly ....even tho' rinsed and rinsed in the shower still had {and have} quite a bit of the residue on the lower part of my face where the "peach fuzz" is. Love the fragrance and the feel of the cleanser......sadly a no go for me. I love all the Bliss products.....just not this item.

Used to be a 5 star product, no residue, no irritation, affordable, you only needed a small dollop to use on your entire face and your skin would GLOW. Skin would feel soft too. I got compliments and had people wondering what I was using. Now it leaves clumps of product STUCK to my facial hair, I can't even wash it off!! I had to shave off the product with a dermablade which using on already freshly cleansed skin just irritated my skin even further... Until a new and improved formula comes or the company returns to the old formula, DO NOT BUY

avis.titre: Good quality and makes the skin feel very smooth
avis.texte: I use this about once or twice a week and my skin feels great afterwards.

This product is amazing! It takes a while to get used to the texture, but believe me just keep going with it, and you’ll be amazed just how well it works. Leaves your skin soft and exfoliated. Would recommend

I was looking forward to using this product. I massaged it into my skin (as I have done other products in the past) but when I went to rinse it off, I found my skin was covered in tiny balls which felt like dead skin peeling off. These balls were stuck in the fine facial hair on my skin, and it took about 40 minutes to remove. I had to pluck, rub, scrub my face, leaving it sensitive. I ended up ripping out baby hair in order to get this product off my face. Since researching this, I see that the gel has some kind of formula in it which becomes like little paper wads on the skin when applied. This product needs to carry a warning, or instructions giving a heads up to people, so that they don't freak out when using it. If you have fine facial hair, do not use this product!
I have very sensitive skin.. But this one just wow.. Makes my skin soft and nourish....

My skin is really sensitive, so I make sure what I buy and check the ingredients in the products so far the ingredients do not seem harsh so I really like that and it does not contain sulfates. I scrub it as hard to see if I will rash my skin but it didn’t my skin feel so clean and gentle and even lighter .. it feel firmer as well.. MUST BUY IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN❤️❤️

Only have used about one or two times, but so far I really like how gentle this exfoliates really is. I don’t have any problems with it coming off at all. I am really glad I purchased this product so far. Recommend this!

This stuff is AMAZING. I've been buying religiously for at least two years. I know it's made for the face but I also use it on my shoulders, chest, other problem areas. It's oddly satisfying to see the little dead skin balls while massaging it in lol. I go through a ton of it, don't know what I'd do without. Can't recommend it enough. Thanks, bliss!

avis.titre: Works great. Not for people with facial hair
avis.texte: I really like this product. As an esthetician in training I am looking at different products to help smooth the skin with out drying it out. This works well. However, because it is a homage type of mask it beads up so I do not think it would be good for a man with facial hair as it would be hard to pick out.

I had something similar to this before, so when I saw it was a gel based exfoliater, I got excited. The scent is mildly off-putting, but not terrible. I have dry, sensitive, skin and this worked beautifully. I didn't get irritated and it left a healthy glow afterwards.

avis.titre: Amazing skincare for removing dead skin.
avis.texte: Very lightly scented. It did not irritate my skin. It is a great dupe for rub-a-dub by Sat Skin and it is much cheaper. Takes away all my dead skin. Leaves my skin soft and glowing. I'm 46 yrs old. It is a part of my skin care for life it is so good.

I bought two of these, I love this brand and I figured ordering on Amazon was better than trying to find this is stores because it's so hard to find. One of the bottles was sealed, with no problems. The other one was opened (you can see in the 2nd picture, the one on the right looks like it's missing a considerable amount). The opened bottle also had some sort of black gunk (possibly mold??) on the lid. I'm hesitant to order from here again

avis.titre: New formula causes dead skin to ball up and cling to my face.
avis.texte: Causes dead skin to cling to the hair on my face in little balls. Never had this issue with the old formula or other brands of peeling gels. Also, do not like the new packaging, it is outdated! The old one was much cuter. Hopefully bliss can reformulate or go back to the old formula.

I have sensitive, dehydrated, acne prone skin. I love the Bliss Rose Rescue products, but this set my face on FIRE. Day 2 after using it, and I am still rinsing my face with ice cold water, rubbing an ice cube over everything, and moisturizing with nothing but alcohol free Aloe Vera or Cica Balm. Another important note: this product contains coconut.

This product is small but mighty. After trying it for the 1st time, I immediately noticed the gel ‘balling up’ and it was my dead skin cells. After washing it off, my face was GLOWING. And it was so soft. I haven’t had my face this soft in years. This is the 2nd product of Bliss I’ve tried and that haven’t disappointed me yet. It’s an effective ‘peel’ but not abrasive at all and works fabulous (for only $10!!!) Don’t hesitate buying this. This is 1000% worth every single penny.
I love this scrub it is very gentle and smells good and it left my skin feeling soft and smooth
